text.ticksight.run_option_sample: Collect sampled stack traces alongside timings. Default: off. Incompatible with calls; supports every scope and peak.
text.ticksight.run_option_peak: Initially show per-object peak time per server tick in the Minecraft overlay (client mod required) and web viewer. Default: average. Combines with sample, calls and every scope.
text.ticksight.run_option_calls: Collect exact method counts and times. Default: off. Requires the matching server Java agent; incompatible with sample. Supports every scope and peak.
text.ticksight.run_option_full: Use -1 (unlimited) method repeats for this calls run only. Requires calls. Global settings stay unchanged; tick, hard tick, memory, heap and report budgets still apply.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-tickets: Skip both Ticket levels and Ticket sources for this run. Other map layers stay enabled.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-runtime: Skip Runtime zones for this run.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-generation: Skip Generation stages for this run.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-ticket-leve: Skip the Ticket levels layer. Ticket sources keep their own native levels.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-ticket-sour: Skip Ticket sources, owner keys and propagation. Effective Ticket levels can still be recorded.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-visibility: Skip Server visibility and queued chunk sends for this run.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-players: Skip the Players map layer: position frames and marker names. CPU object timings are unchanged.
text.ticksight.run_option_no-layers: Skip all map layers, or keep only the adjacent layer names that follow. Any other modifier closes this list. Negative flags always win. CPU profiling is unchanged.
text.ticksight.run_option_runtime: Keep Runtime zones inside the adjacent no-layers list.
text.ticksight.run_option_generation: Keep Generation stages inside the adjacent no-layers list.
text.ticksight.run_option_ticket-levels: Keep Ticket levels inside the adjacent no-layers list.
text.ticksight.run_option_ticket-sources: Keep Ticket sources inside the adjacent no-layers list.
text.ticksight.run_option_visibility: Keep Server visibility inside the adjacent no-layers list.
text.ticksight.run_option_players: Keep Players inside the adjacent no-layers list.
text.ticksight.run_layer_position: %s is only allowed directly after no-layers or another layer in that list.
text.ticksight.run_layer_expected: Choose a layer from the adjacent no-layers list, or continue with a run modifier.
text.ticksight.run_option_in: Only collect objects in this dimension, in all modes. Without in or a scope, include all dimensions. Areas, block and numeric entity ID default to the source dimension. Coordinates follow Minecraft's execute in: source X/Z are scaled between dimensions; absolute coordinates stay as entered. No chunks are loaded.
text.ticksight.run_option_radius: Choose circle or sphere. b means blocks (default); c means chunks of 16 blocks. The center defaults to the command source position.
text.ticksight.run_option_circle: Use the radius in X/Z from the center's height down to the world bottom. Requires radius.
text.ticksight.run_option_sphere: Use the radius in 3D around the center. Requires radius.
text.ticksight.run_option_box: Inclusive block corners in either order; absolute, relative (~) and local (^) positions. Fixed source dimension unless in is supplied. One scope per run.
text.ticksight.run_option_chunks: Inclusive chunk X/Z rectangle at the full world height; negative coordinates and either order work. Default: one chunk. Uses loaded ticking objects only. One scope per run.
text.ticksight.run_option_entity: Only this entity, in every mode. Native UUID/selector lookup; numeric ID is looked up in the in/source dimension. An explicit in must match the selected entity. One scope per run; never enables calls implicitly.
text.ticksight.run_option_block: Only ticks at this block position, in every mode. Uses the in/source dimension; supports absolute, relative (~) and local (^) coordinates and aimed-block suggestions. One scope per run; never enables calls implicitly.
text.ticksight.configure_title: TickSight settings — click a row to edit its DEFAULT in chat, then send to save.
text.ticksight.setting_write_failed: Could not save %s: %s. Running settings were kept.
text.ticksight.settings_reset: TickSight settings reset to defaults and saved.
text.ticksight.setting_traceInterval: Base pause between stack samples, in ms. Fractions are allowed.
text.ticksight.setting_deviation: Maximum random variation of the pause, capped to keep the delay positive.
text.ticksight.setting_allPlayersAllowed: Allow every player to use the client profiler UI. Operator level 4 is still required for server commands.
text.ticksight.setting_allowedPlayers: Player UUID allowlist for the client profiler UI. Set a JSON array inside a quoted command string, e.g. "[\"01234567-89ab-4cde-9012-3456789abcde\"]". Use "[]" for an empty set.
text.ticksight.setting_includeJvmArgs: Include JVM launch flags in report diagnostics. true includes them; false redacts JVM Flags.
text.ticksight.setting_uploadURL: Absolute HTTP(S) profile upload endpoint. Use an empty quoted string ("") to disable uploads and retain reports locally.
text.ticksight.setting_callTraceTickLimi: Positive full server tick time limit during call recording, in ms. Crossing it ends the recording and exports a partial report.
text.ticksight.setting_callTraceMaxRepea: Method invocations to trace per parent path, object and tick. -1 means unlimited; 0 or larger limits descendant tracing while retaining exact parent count/time. full overrides it for one run.
text.ticksight.setting_callTraceHardTick: Positive hard tick deadline in ms, checked by an independent watchdog. Stops instrumentation; Minecraft finishes its tick before the partial report is exported.
text.ticksight.setting_callTraceMemoryLi: Positive memory budget for call recording and export, in MiB. Stops recording before budgeted growth and preserves the partial report.
text.ticksight.setting_callTraceHeapRese: Nonnegative JVM heap headroom to preserve during call recording, in MiB. Recording stops when available heap falls below this reserve.
text.ticksight.help_intro: Start: /ticksight run <duration> [modifiers...]. Click a help topic or example to insert it in chat, then send.
text.ticksight.help_click: Insert this command into chat for review/editing. Nothing is executed until you send it.
text.ticksight.help_commands_short: Commands: run, stop, configure, set, allow, deny, tp, reset. All require operator level 4.
text.ticksight.help_topic_scopes: dimension, radius, box, chunks, entity and block
text.ticksight.help_topic_calls: exact calls, full and safety limits
text.ticksight.help_run: run <N|Ns|Nt> [modifiers...]. 3 and 3s mean 3 seconds; 60t means 60 server ticks. Default: average timings and all map layers. no-* flags skip layers for this run; no-layers players keeps only Players. Use each modifier once and choose at most one scope. sample conflicts with calls; full requires calls. See help scopes for targeting.
text.ticksight.help_scopes: Choose radius, box, chunks, entity or block. radius requires circle or sphere. Put at after radius and to after chunks; other modifiers can go between them. in limits the dimension and scales the source position for relative coordinates, as with execute in. Absolute coordinates stay as entered. UUID and selector can find an entity in another dimension; explicit in must match it. Only loaded chunks are measured.
text.ticksight.help_calls: calls collects exact counts with the matching -javaagent; sample collects stack samples instead. Peak changes only the initial viewer. full sets repeats=-1 for this run only, requires calls and keeps all budgets. Defaults: configured safety values (see configure); stop exports a partial recording. Every target form works without enabling calls implicitly.
text.ticksight.help_settings: configure lists settings. Click to edit. traceInterval and deviation accept fractional milliseconds. allow and deny take a player name or player selector. For UUIDs, use set allowedPlayers with a quoted JSON array. reset restores defaults.
text.ticksight.help_commands: run <duration> [modifiers...] starts a profile. stop exports the data collected so far. configure opens the settings menu. set <field> <value> saves a setting. allow and deny change profiler screen access by player name or selector. tp <dimension> entity <numericId> or position <x y z> teleports you. reset restores defaults. Commands require operator level 4.
text.ticksight.run_option_at: Set the center after radius. Default: source position in the selected dimension. Supports absolute, ~ and ^ coordinates.
text.ticksight.run_option_to: Set the second inclusive corner after chunks. Default: the first corner (one chunk).
text.ticksight.run_parse_failed: Could not recover the native command context. No profile was started. Please report this command to TickSight.
text.ticksight.run_unknown_option: Unknown run modifier: %s. Use /ticksight help run or help scopes.
